title: Pearl Fintech Landing Page Overview
whatItIs: A presentation of a long pearl-toned landing page for a finance app shown as two offset columns: a hero with a serif headline and a phone, trusted-by logos, about and stats, a feature grid, and at right a global services row, testimonial portraits, three-tier pricing, a phone download section with a QR code and a footer with a giant brand name.
whatItMeans: Serif headlines and pearl gradients feel refined and calm for finance, and the overview shows every section at a glance.
techniques: Serif headlines on a pearl gradient

Three-tier pricing with a highlighted middle plan
